name: R
note: Statistics-focused language from the S lineage with a strong FP substrate
typeSystem: Dynamic. Atomic vectors and lists are fundamental data structures, and many operations use implicit vectorisation and coercion.
runtime: GNU R evaluates expressions and can byte-compile functions; user-visible objects generally have copy-on-modify semantics

runtimes.name: GNU R
runtimes.role: Reference interpreter with an internal bytecode compiler.

runtimes.name: FastR
runtimes.role: GraalVM-based R implementation with a JIT.
